source address (no success from that source in between), followed by a successful

rules.description:
An archive file was created and the same host then sent a large amount of data to
a public address. "Possible exfiltration" is a hypothesis: volume does not prove
data theft and the archive content is unknown.
rules.explanation: Archive then >=50MB outbound from {group} within {window_s}s. Data theft is NOT established.

rules.required_evidence: File creation + connection with direction-declared byte counters on same host
sources: FBI FLASH-20261113-001 (staging and exfiltration, outbound structured data transfers)
rules.title: Archive created then large outbound transfer from the same host
